mapper.sql: select id, user_id, event_type, target_type, target_id, title, summary, cover, created_time from portal_feed_event
mapper.select: select fe.id as event_id, fe.user_id as user_id, coalesce(pu.nickname, pu.username) as user_nickname, pu.avatar as user_avatar, fe.event_type as event_type, fe.target_type as target_type, fe.target_id as target_id, fe.title as title, fe.summary as summary, fe.cover as cover, fe.created_time as created_time from portal_feed_event fe inner join portal_follow pf on pf.following_id = fe.user_id inner join portal_user pu on pu.id = fe.user_id where pf.follower_id = #{userId} order by fe.created_time desc

select fe.id as event_id, fe.user_id as user_id, coalesce(pu.nickname, pu.username) as user_nickname, pu.avatar as user_avatar, fe.event_type as event_type, fe.target_type as target_type, fe.target_id as target_id, fe.title as title, fe.summary as summary, fe.cover as cover, fe.created_time as created_time from portal_feed_event fe left join portal_user pu on pu.id = fe.user_id where fe.created_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) order by fe.created_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into portal_feed_event (user_id, event_type, target_type, target_id, title, summary, cover, created_time) values (#{userId}, #{eventType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{cover}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} order by created_time desc
mapper.delete: delete from portal_feed_event where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
